name: MPG Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: MPG Corporation Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an entertainment retailer in Thailand. The company produces and distributes technology equipment and cosmetics, as well as music and movie in the form of CDs, DVDs, and blu-rays; and acquires copyrights for music and movies. It is also involved in the renewal energy business. The company was formerly known as Mangpong 1989 Public Company Limited and changed its name to MPG Corporation Public Company Limited in October 2015. MPG Corporation Public Company Limited was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
